synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints **ALL PASS** (30/30 transitions match exactly).

The rule in `program.py`:

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Rows | Legends with the same `y` make one row. |
| Words | In a row, legends with a gap of 2 or less make one word. This is why the cursor skips x=27: the legends at x=20 and x=27 are one word. |
| Cursor position | The cursor is on the first legend of a word. It keeps its vertical offset to the legend row. |
| Action 4 | The cursor moves to the next word. After the last word in a row, it goes to the next row. After the last row, it goes back to the first row. |
| Action 3 | The cursor moves to the previous word. |
| Other actions | No change. |

The data does not show these two rules, so they are guesses:
- When action 3 is used on the first word, I assume that the cursor goes back to the last word.
- Actions 1 and 2 had no visible effect in all 30 transitions. They possibly change something that the state does not show. No transition used actions 5, 6 or 7.
